messages.content: Hi, my company wants 60 one-kg kaju katli gift boxes delivered to our office in Ludhiana next Friday.

Sure, 60 × 1 kg Kaju Katli boxes would be about:

- Kaju Katli: 60 kg × ₹1,100 = ₹66,000  
- 1 kg gift‑box packing: 60 boxes × ₹80 = ₹4,800  

Estimated total ≈ ₹70,800 (prices may vary during festivals; the team will confirm the final amount).

To raise an enquiry, could you please share:

1. Your full name and WhatsApp (or phone) number.  
2. The exact delivery address of your office in Ludhiana.  

Once I have those, I’ll forward the details to the Mehra Sweets team.
My name is Neha Arora, company Arora Textiles, WhatsApp +91 98765 43210. Please deliver to the Arora Textiles office in Ludhiana; your team can take the exact address on WhatsApp.

Got it, Neha. I have:

- 60 × 1 kg Kaju Katli gift boxes (1 kg box packaging)  
- Delivery to Arora Textiles office, Ludhiana (exact address to be shared on WhatsApp)  
- Needed by Friday 16 October 2026 (time to be confirmed)

Shall I send this to the Mehra Sweets team?
The Mehra Sweets team will contact you on WhatsApp shortly to confirm the order and final price.
Thank you. Our team will be in touch shortly.
